mapper.sql: id, event_id, creator_id, note_id, operation_type, topic, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, lease_owner, lease_until, lease_version, created_time, updated_time, sent_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_operate_outbox (event_id, creator_id, note_id, operation_type, topic, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_version, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{creatorId}, #{noteId}, #{operationType}, #{topic}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_note_operate_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_note_operate_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_version = lease_version + 1, updated_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}))
